steps.content: When you open your eyes drowsily, you find yourself sitting in the phone booth. Outside are the familiar street, familiar crowd, and familiar darkness.
And the familiar Mania...
As you think, you find that the notebook and fountain pen you carry with you have been taken out of your pocket and placed next to you. It's also at this time that you realize that Nino is gone.
You open the notebook to the page holding the fountain pen. There's a small paragraph written crookedly on it, but the signature at the bottom is mature and fluid.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Nino Sama... How long did you practice that...
When you wake up and find that I'm gone, don't worry! I'm doing great!
I've already checked for you. This world is much safer than the last one! The weird guys here won't try to transform us into them!

<i>But I suddenly thought of something I must deal with, 
so I gotta go now!

Don't worry, I'll make sure to be careful. 
You see, I was the one who saved you in the last world, right? 
I'm sure you can solve the problem and find the voice this world
really needs!<i>
When you finish reading the note, Eleven beside you also wakes up. She stares blankly at the identical world in front of her, eyes full of surprise.
You show her the note and reassure her. Nino is a bright girl, and just like she said, it was her who saved you in the first place.

You push the door open and walk out of the phone booth with Eleven, entering this city that is both familiar and strange to you. You look back at the phone booth which stands there alone, waiting for people to go in and out or pass by it.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: "I get a strange feeling about this world... It makes me want to escape immediately, but my feet feel stuck."

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: "Even though it looks so much more peaceful and quiet than the last world..."
Eleven typed two lines on the communication device and showed them to you.
Your feeling is the same as hers. Everything here is just like the last world you've left behind, but somehow everything feels more unpleasant.

On the nighttime street, the strange people with alien heads don't instantly pounce at you wanting to transform you like in the last world. They lurk in sparse groups, all hunching as if crushed by something.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: They look so haggard... Their expression is blank, but you can tell they're about to snap...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It's as if their souls have been drained.
Their walking speed and the way they get on the bus are almost identical, as if they are all puppets worn out from being fiddled with for too long.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...It feels somewhat familiar.
You think of the meeting this morning. The whole conference room was gloomy, not particularly different from the scene in your sight.
You shake your head and throw the work-related anxiety out of your mind. You mull over the hint the ghost lady gave you in the phone booth.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What kind of voice... does this world need?

Based on the experience in the last world, Eleven hid in the record store because she couldn't find the key to crack it. When you arrived, she remembered the voice she'd lost. So... what would she think this time?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Do you have any ideas, Eleven?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: About this world, and about... what you want to say.
Eleven shakes her head and looks toward a building not far away. After staring at it for a while, she lowers her head to type for you.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: "I... don't have any clues, but I feel there must be something here..."
Eleven opens her mouth. The slight strain of veins on her neck shows that she is trying hard to speak.
Unfortunately, she still can't say anything except words of refusal.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: "Because over there..."
Eleven points to the building she's been staring at.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: "That's the TV station... where I work."

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: "I heard the poem in the phone booth... I once recited it in my show..."

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: "Perhaps... her hint might be related to this?"
You look up and see that under the night sky past midnight, several floors of the building are still lit, and some windows are flickering with lights.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Still working at this ungodly hour... They're insane...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Insanely professional, I mean...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But what you said makes sense. She seems to be delivering clues in each call, and since this has appeared in your show, we should go check it out.
